tools.name: list_platforms
tools.description: List the e-commerce platforms covered (Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Magento 2, Magento 1, PrestaShop, Shopware, Wix, Squarespace, custom) with their MCP support status and how many MCP options each has.

tools.name: get_platform
tools.description: Full detail for one e-commerce platform: MCP status, summary, every known MCP option (official and community) with access level and caution, where to start, and FAQ.

tools.name: list_servers
tools.description: Browse the directory of MCP servers relevant to online stores and agencies. Filter by category, access level, vendor-published only, or a free-text query. Returns summaries; use get_server for depth.

tools.name: get_server
tools.description: Everything the directory knows about one MCP server: what it does, who it is best for, what to watch out for, and where available a setup walkthrough, example prompts, limits, safety notes and FAQ.

tools.name: match_servers
tools.description: The site's matchmaker. Given an e-commerce platform and optional goals, return the MCP servers that fit (official first, read-only first), with honest gaps where nothing exists yet.

tools.name: search_guides
tools.description: Search the site's plain-English guides on MCP for e-commerce (connecting Claude or ChatGPT to Shopify, Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4, security, agencies, agentic commerce). Returns each guide's short answer; use get_guide for the full text.

tools.name: get_guide
tools.description: Full text of one guide in Markdown, with its short answer, FAQ and sources.

tools.name: lookup_term
tools.description: Plain-English definitions of MCP, e-commerce, advertising, analytics and tracking terms (MCP server, OAuth, prompt injection, POAS, ROAS, CAPI, GA4, SKU, LTV and about 160 more).

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "match_servers" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: The site's matchmaker. Given an e-commerce platform and optional goals, return the MCP servers that fit (official first, read-only first), with honest gaps wher…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
